# Character Arc

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CharacterArc`](gmeow-CharacterArc.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CharacterArc>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)

A first-class interpretive/structural information object describing a character's trajectory through a narrative — a standpoint-scoped analysis, never canonical truth. A [gufo:Kind](../../external/terms.md#gufo-kind) with distinct identity criteria (subject, frame, and type). Cross-continuity variants are linked by [`counterpartOf`](../properties/gmeow-counterpartOf.md), never merged.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:CharacterArc`](gmeow-CharacterArc.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
